title: golden-parity SHAPE GEOMETRY hard-fail: 3 DefineShape records unmatched (regression)
description:
RESOLVED (merged with the QA-finding duplicate that collided on a shared numeric prefix). This QA finding (golden-parity SHAPE GEOMETRY hard-fail) and the fix task that was re-filed under a fresh number (formerly 1217-shape-geometry-golden-parity-regression, status done) are the SAME work; reconciled into this single record per task 1206.

REPRO (original QA finding): export PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH"; node tools/golden-parity.mjs exited 1 on SHAPE GEOMETRY -- 3 of our DefineShape records had no record-signature match in golden.swf (bounds matched exactly; only the edge-record signature differed). The two filled+stroked circles emitted ~2x golden's edge records (18 vs 9, 10 vs 5) because the importer reconstructed a filled-and-stroked region as TWO separate closed paths (fill-only + identical stroke-only). Regression bisected to 035796d (fill0/fill1 closed-loop reconstruction in convertShape) -- the gradient work was NOT the cause.

FIX (merged at commit dbdd979): packages/swf/src/shapes.ts coalesceFillStrokePairs() merges an adjacent fill-only + byte-identical stroke-only pair into ONE combined fill+stroke loop, matching Flash's single-loop encoding. 2 shapes now record-match; the 3rd (rounded-rect gradient button face) is the documented gradient-fill expansion -> golden-parity bounds-matches it and reports KNOWN-GAP.

VERIFY: node tools/golden-parity.mjs -> exit 0; all hard dimensions PASS. @flash/swf tests pass (3 new tests in shapes.test.ts 'DefineShape4 fill+stroke coalescing'). @flash/core 327/330 (3 fails = missing fixtures/flash8-empty.fla, task 1207). See CLAUDE.md 'The encoder coalesces a fill-only + coincident stroke-only path pair'.
